text: After working as a school inspector, {Name} supervised police near {Place}. When residents came to the police office seeking protection from soldiers, the former inspector ordered the visitors detained.
self_review: A former school inspector took charge of police and ordered residents seeking protection detained.
source_pattern: The supplied Akayesu judgment documents a school inspector becoming a local official with police authority and later participating in crimes.
fictional_changes: The police-supervisor appointment and detention of petitioners are fictional. The card omits real communities, chronology, crimes, and political identities.
